digest: finding-001 KEEP: src/workflow-stop.ts:67 uses a 200ms default and a 1ms floor, but SPEC S3 requires a 50ms default and no value below 10ms.

evidence.relevance: Default is 200 instead of 50, and the clamp floor is 1 instead of 10.

evidence.quote: 기본값은 50ms이고, 호출자가 더 작은 값을 주어도 10ms보다

evidence.relevance: S3 forbids effective values shorter than 10ms.

finalClaim: createWorkflowStopSignal uses a 200ms default poll interval and clamps caller values to a 1ms floor, contrary to SPEC S3 (50ms default, nothing below 10ms). No caller in the repo passes pollMs and no test exercises the default or clamp, so nothing mitigates it.
recommendedAction: Change the default to 50 and the floor to 10 in createWorkflowStopSignal (src/workflow-stop.ts:67), then add a unit test for S3 covering the default and the clamp.
